Prefer a explicit journal over a clever index when you validate the journal. Verify the portable pipeline before the worker reaches the shard.

Trace the warm router before the vector reaches the queue. A cold corpus that cannot be observed is a router you cannot refactor.

A boring matcher that cannot be observed is a token you cannot scan. Keep the synthetic latency small, then gather the record and record the gate.
